fixtureProvenance: Synthetic repository history, PRs and token canaries authored against the retained Gitea 1.23.4 schemas. A loopback git http-backend serves temporary native Git repositories. No live Gitea observations.
checkout: Installed clone and PR checkout verify exact commits and credential-free remotes. Dirty work is preserved. Repository creation publishes exact source history; forks retain their parent and cloned history. Revert preparation verifies the inverse merge tree; separately confirmed publication creates a PR for the recorded generated commit.
stacks: Three owned branches exercise navigation, selected-remote publication, PR linking and base reconciliation, dependency-ordered merge into trunk, stop-on-failure checkpoints, safe completed-branch pruning, tracked-only staging, rebase date handling, native conflict abort/continue and interrupted-push reconciliation without replay.
effects: Local and API mutations use the shared effect policy, exact operation grants, bound confirmations, durable receipts and a secret-free journal. Preview leaves work, refs, stack metadata and upstream business state unchanged. Changed workspace state invalidates confirmation. Native Git uses argument arrays and an origin-scoped credential environment.

artium.channels: Real bundled local client, server, credential writer and runner with fake Gitea; admission refuses local checkout commands and composite workspace flags, and every stack command. No host source change is needed.
artium.reports: Final-head opt-in reports retain tested source head, fixture revision, manifest digest, package digest and result outside the public repository. Ordinary npm test explicitly skips Artium when its frozen fixture selectors are absent.

pending.submit: Required automatic merge scheduling is not verified; submit refuses before effects with an explicit compatibility gap.
pending.preserveDates: Explicit compatibility-gap refusal before effects until upstream date semantics are evidenced.
pending.browser: Submit/link --open refuse before effects; browser canaries verify no launch. Browser launch outside auth login remains prohibited.
